policy: External methodologies may inform native design but do not execute inside the predictive runtime without a separate evidence gate.

rejected_runtime_frameworks.CrewAI: role-based orchestration already exists natively; no measured gain justifies a second runtime
rejected_runtime_frameworks.LangGraph-runtime: durability patterns are useful, but native SMART state/hashes already cover the current need
rejected_runtime_frameworks.Microsoft-Agent-Framework: cooperative runtime would duplicate current deterministic handoffs
rejected_runtime_frameworks.Dify: visual workflow layer is not required by the canonical headless execution path
rejected_runtime_frameworks.LlamaIndex-Workflows: document/event workflow runtime does not close a current material project gap
